senses.gloss: --one of the उपायस् of a king. M. २२२. 2.

--a manifestation of Hari born of Aditi and कश्यप. He was known as वामन because of his short stature.
1: भा. X. 3. ४२: V. २४. २४; VI. 6. ३९; वा. ९८. ८४; Br. III. २१. ५९; ७३. ८४.
Anointed by gods as the Lord of all worlds. Helped Indra his elder brother in the administration of his kingdoms.
2: भा. VIII. २३. २३-25.
Knew the योग power of Hari
3: Ib. II. 7. ४५; 5. ३०; IV. 2. १८.
and was invoked by gopas for the protection of the baby कृष्ण.
4: Ib. X. 6. २२ and २३;
Had a son बृहत्श्लोक through कीर्ति.
5: Ib. VI. १८. 8.
Also known as Uru- krama. A son of Diti.
6: M. १४६. २०; २४४. २६-8.
कृष्ण, crowned by Indra as the Indra of cows, urged by the speech of Gava; perhaps the cows of heaven like the कामधेनु; at that time the cattle delighted the earth with milk.
7: Vi. V. १२. १२-15.
